name: Eclipsed realms
description: Pockets that emerge where the boundaries of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor grind together, a third state of neither light nor shadow that slowly transforms those who stay in them.

timeline.summary: Eclipsed realms begin to appear, as tales emerge of places caught between light and darkness.
timeline.quote: These areas came to be known as eclipsed realms.

relations.note: They form along the borders between aspects.
relations.quote: They exist along the borders between aspects
